messages:
Samir Patel: Quick scheduling ping — candidate Elena (SWE II) completed take-home, ready for onsite panel. Proposed slot: Thu 11/6 11:00am PT. Panel = Maya K, Jordan R, Priya S, Lucas Kim. Can everyone confirm availability by EOD today? Also need a debrief lead + someone to own the code-review notes.
Maya K: I can do debrief lead if it's 11:00 exactly. If it moves to 11:30 I might drop — have a recurring sync. :thumbsup:
Jordan R: 11:00 works for me. If we need to move, 12:00 is also ok.
Priya S: I have a calendar conflict 11:00–11:30, can do 11:30 or 12:00. Sorry I missed the initial message.
Lucas Kim: I can cover code-review notes. Prefer 11:00 but flexible to 12:00.
Samir Patel: Thanks — sounds like 11:30 or 12:00 might be more inclusive. Quick preference poll: reply with 1 for 11:00, 2 for 11:30, 3 for 12:00.
Maya K: 2
Jordan R: 3 (but can do 2 if needed)
Priya S: 3
Lucas Kim: 1
Samir Patel: Tally = 11:00(1), 11:30(1+Jordan fallback), 12:00(2). Leaning 12:00 then. I'll send updated hold. Can Lucas still take code-review owner at 12?
Lucas Kim: Yep, will own code notes and drop a short summary in the #hiring-debriefs doc.
Samir Patel: Great. Two quick rubric clarifications before the panel: (a) We weight system design 30%, coding 40%, collaboration + product 30%. (b) Please use the single debrief thread and fill the score section — we aggregate automatically.
Priya S: Quick Q on scoring scale: do we use 1–5 or 1–10? The sheet shows both in different places.
Maya K: We standardize on 1–5 in the rubric. I'll update the template to remove the 1–10 bit.
Samir Patel: Thanks — action items: (1) Samir send updated calendar hold for Thu 12:00 PT with Zoom link and interview packet, (2) Lucas to draft code-review summary during panel, (3) Maya to update rubric template to 1–5, (4) Everyone to complete scores in debrief thread within 2 hours of interview.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Elena — SWE II panel" Thu 12:00 PT. Guests invited: Maya K, Jordan R, Priya S, Lucas Kim, Samir Patel. Link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
Jordan R: Noted. I'll block the 12:00 slot instead.
Priya S: Swapped my conflict, confirmed 12:00.
Maya K: Updated rubric template and added a short example scoring comment to the doc.
Samir Patel: All set — thanks team. If anything changes, ping here. :rocket:
